title: Pancakes
description: Fluffy golden pancakes made from scratch, great with maple syrup and fresh fruit.
instructions: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt together in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat.
Pour about a quarter cup of batter per pancake and cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Serve warm with syrup, butter, or fruit.
